items.excerpt: At Made on YouTube, the company expanded its AI creator suite with a background agent that optimizes a channel's back catalog and now generates entire thumbnails and titles from an uploaded video, plus gives feedback on creators' own designs.
items.title: YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them

items.excerpt: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, which it says matches its flagship Fable 5.1 on most work at roughly 40% lower cost than Opus 5, shipping with tighter cybersecurity safeguards.
items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with stricter safeguards for cybersecurity

items.excerpt: Argues AI transformation is owned less by the chief AI officer than by 'builders' close to the work who redesign their own workflows, and that orgs should measure how people rethink work with AI rather than usage counts.
items.title: Who actually owns AI transformation?

items.excerpt: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, faster and cheaper models carrying GPT-6 Astra's advances, are live on Vercel AI Gateway and callable from the AI SDK and v0 builds.
items.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna now available on AI Gateway

items.excerpt: Grok 4.7 from xAI is now available on Vercel AI Gateway, eve and fx, discounted 40% for a week starting September 21.
items.title: Grok 4.7 now available and 40% off on AI Gateway, fx, and eve

items.excerpt: Builder.io introduces Agent-Native Plans, a free open-source tool for reviewing what a coding agent plans to build and what it built, so teams agree on intent up front instead of watching tool calls.
items.title: Stop watching your agent work

items.excerpt: An essay on how websites and interfaces built for human visitors break down as AI agents become primary users, and what product and front-end teams need to redesign.
items.title: The Internet Is Not Ready for the Agentic Wave

items.excerpt: Citing Figma data that 56% of hiring managers want more senior designers vs 25% hiring juniors, Patrick Neeman argues AI tools have absorbed starter work and design leaders must deliberately grow junior judgment.
items.title: In the age of AI, the UX field survives on leaders who cultivate juniors

items.excerpt: An interaction-design pattern for browser agents: show users the actual page state and target element before they approve an agent's click, rather than a bare text confirmation.
items.title: Show the Page State Before Approving an Agent Click

items.excerpt: AI builds screens fast, but exported React still has to be remapped to the existing design system's components and tokens; the post proposes generating directly inside the UI kit so there is no handoff.
items.title: Design-to-Code Is Still a Handoff. What If There Was No Handoff?

items.excerpt: (Italian) From props-driven SPAs to declarative and truly generative UI: how interfaces change when a model generates full screens, and what guarantees (components, accessibility, constraints) teams need to ship them.
items.title: Oltre i componenti: come cambia la UI quando la genera un modello

items.excerpt: DLSS 5 adds a 3D-guided neural rendering stage that uses the engine's artist-authored geometry, textures and lighting buffers as a fixed base while adding lifelike lighting and material detail, with granular controls to preserve artistic intent.
items.title: What's New for Game Developers: DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering

items.excerpt: NVIDIA released Isaac ROS 5.0, adding agentic AI workflows in which coding agents help build and accelerate ROS 2 nodes for physical-AI robot development, alongside new open-source packages.
items.title: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 Advances Agentic, Open Source Robotics Development

items.excerpt: COMSOL previewed Multiphysics 2027 with an MCP server so AI agents can drive simulation models, Onshape users can now run SimScale simulations via an AI agent, plus Autodesk corrections on neural CAD's status after AU 2026.
items.title: Multiphysics gets MCP server and Onshape gets SimScale agent

items.excerpt: Jesse Showalter demos Framer Skills, which lets designers save custom instructions and repeatable workflows so Framer's AI agent works the way they do instead of one-off prompts.
items.title: I taught Framer my workflow

items.excerpt: AI Jason combines GPT-6 with the Hyperframe video framework so an AI agent can produce polished, expert-level explainer videos, walking through the agent-driven video workflow.
items.title: GPT 6 + Hyperframe = Crazy combo for expert-level videos

items.excerpt: Matt Wolfe reviews Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol, two frontier models launched on the same day, and what each changes for everyday AI work.
items.title: Opus 5.5 Is Crazy Good and GPT-6-Sol Launched Too
